clues.it: Fabio era l'unico seduto su una sedia.
clues.en: Fabio was the only one sitting on a chair.
Marta was beside a suit of armor.

clues.it: Ugo era da solo nelle Segrete.
clues.en: Ugo was alone in the Dungeon.

clues.it: Carla era l'unica persona su della paglia.
clues.en: Carla was the only person on a bed of straw.

clues.it: LA VITTIMA. Era da solo con l'assassino.
clues.en: The Victim. Was alone with the murderer.

steps.it: L'indizio di Fabio lascia una sola casella libera: riga 1ª, colonna 2ª.
steps.en: Fabio's own clue leaves a single free square: row 1st, column 2nd.

steps.it: Giada può stare solo nella 1ª colonna: escludendola, a Marta resta una sola casella: riga 2ª, colonna 7ª.
steps.en: Giada can only be in the 1st column: ruling it out leaves Marta a single square: row 2nd, column 7th.
